card.name: Dosing words in insulin and tablet instructions
card.fires_on: Words in dosing instructions just before a likely continuation, such as 'tablets' before 'with meals', 'pre' in pre-meal insulin, or partway through a pen or drug name. Mostly insulin, injection-device and tablet directions.
